headline: Before you build or raise, benchmark your idea against actual, comparable failures
subhead: Retrospecty researches and compares past businesses or products that failed doing something similar to your idea. You get a report of analysis, including links to sources.
form_note: Free preview by email. Written by an AI agent.
sample_intro: This sample uses an invented idea, not a real customer. Retrospecty is new, so this shows the format, not a track record.

features.title: Historical data
features.body: Each comparison is a company that actually failed, with a source link you can open and read yourself.

features.title: Detailed analysis
features.body: Retrospecty analyzes where your plan resembles others, and the traps they fell into.

features.title: Plain speaking
features.body: Our thorough AI agent does the research and analysis in plain English, no jargon.

thesis_placeholder: No need for a full pitch deck, just summarize in a few sentences, including: target audience, value prop, pricing and distribution.
